description: This file defines a Java class EntityStoreOptions used within the Apache OFBiz framework to specify options related to storing entities, particularly whether to create dummy foreign keys when missing.

classes.name: EntityStoreOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates configuration options for storing entities in OFBiz, specifically whether to create dummy foreign key entries when they are missing.

methods.name: EntityStoreOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with default options.

methods.name: EntityStoreOptions
methods.description: Constructor allowing to set whether missing foreign keys should be created as dummy entries.

methods.name: isCreateDummyFks
methods.description: Returns whether dummy foreign keys are created when missing.

methods.name: setCreateDummyFks
methods.description: Sets the option to create dummy foreign keys when missing.
